concepts.gloss_en: The first teshuvah (repentance) — the first of the two teshuvahs in Torah 6, aspect of the glory of this world, upon which one later does a second teshuvah (glory of the World to Come)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in Torah 6 and refer to the same idea: the first repentance that one later repents upon (occ:3255 partner 'teshuvah on the first teshuvah'; occ:1461 explicitly 'the first teshuvah = honor of this world'). The only difference between the two surface forms is the definite article on the noun (התשובה vs תשובה), which is inflectional variation of the same phrase, not a homograph or archetype/generic split. Safe to merge.
